findings.current: Not long ago, even the Sect Leader came looking for you and asked whether something had happened to you.
findings.defect: The surname Lee is omitted from “Sect Leader Lee,” removing the cue that prompts Taekyung to identify Lee Seowol in the next line.
findings.rationale: 이 문주 means “Sect Leader Lee,” not merely “the Sect Leader.” Preserving the surname maintains the dialogue’s immediate logic.
findings.replacement: Not long ago, even Sect Leader Lee came looking for you and asked whether something had happened to you.
findings.source: 얼마 전에는 이 문주까지 찾아와 묻더군요. 주군께 무슨 변고라도 생기신 거 아니냐고.

findings.current: Great Hero Cheol Mubaek, who was a friend of her late father, has also ended his seclusion and is taking an active role in the affairs of the Mount Heng Sword Sect.
findings.defect: Cheol Mubaek’s established sobriquet, Tiger of Mount Heng, is omitted.
findings.rationale: 항산호 is an explicit established title in the source and glossary.
findings.replacement: Great Hero Cheol Mubaek, the Tiger of Mount Heng and a friend of her late father, has also ended his seclusion and is taking an active role in the affairs of the Mount Heng Sword Sect.
findings.source: 선친의 벗이었던 항산호(恒山虎) 철무백 대협도 은거를 깨고 항산검문의 일에 적극적으로 나서고 있고요.

findings.current: Judging by how Jin Wikyung kept clearing his throat, he seemed to have more than a few guilty spots.
findings.defect: “Guilty spots” is an unnatural literal rendering of an idiom meaning that he had plenty to feel guilty about.
findings.rationale: 찔리는 구석이 한둘이 아니다 describes numerous matters weighing on his conscience, not literal or figurative “spots.”
findings.replacement: Judging by how Jin Wikyung kept clearing his throat, he clearly had plenty to feel guilty about.
findings.source: 연신 헛기침을 내뱉는 진위경의 모습을 보니 찔리는 구석이 한둘이 아닌 모양이다.

findings.defect: “Ominous” adds a sense of impending danger absent from the awkward, suggestive atmosphere of the source.
findings.rationale: 묘하다 here means odd or peculiar, as Taekyung begins to suspect Lee Seowol may have personal feelings for him.
findings.replacement: Something about the atmosphere felt strange.

findings.current: Jang Taebo’s eyes were utterly vacant as he was recruited as the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s dedicated servant—no, slave.
findings.defect: Rendering 도비 as the generic “servant” erases the explicit Dobby reference and therefore the correction-based punchline from “Dobby” to “slave.”
findings.rationale: 도비 is Dobby, the enslaved house-elf, and 아니 노비 deliberately pivots from that name to the Korean word for a slave.
findings.replacement: Jang Taebo’s eyes were utterly vacant as he was recruited as the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s personal Dobby—no, slave.
findings.source: 태원진가의 전속 도비, 아니 노비로 영입된 장태보의 눈빛은 공허하기 그지없었다.

summary: Five actionable findings: two omitted identity/title cues, two localized prose defects, and a lost Dobby punchline.
